use_case_name: Initialize a Newly Online Control Unit

claims.content: The system identifies the newly online control unit and initializes it along with all its associated device sensors.

goal.raw_text: The system identifies the newly online control unit and initializes it along with all its associated device sensors.

claims.content: Control Unit
A workstation or control unit (FCU or DCU) comes online.

trigger.raw_text: A workstation or control unit (FCU or DCU) comes online.

claims.content: The system identifies the workstation or control unit (FCU or DCU) and all its associated device sensors when it comes online.
The RLCS software in the field identifies its unit by reading the cabinet ID.
The system verifies that all required cards in the unit are present and working properly.
The system performs a control system integrity check.
The system initializes all specified tables.
Upon successful completion of the startup process (which shall not exceed 30 seconds), the system monitors all devices.
The system sends the current status to the FCU or TSU every 2 seconds (or at the rate specified in System Control Parameters).
If the control system integrity check fails during initialization, the system shall cause an alarm condition for the affected control unit and prevent it from being used in control sequences.
If a status from any device is not received upon request during initialization, the system shall automatically request the status again.
If the control system integrity check fails during initialization, the system shall cause an alarm condition for the affected control unit and prevent it from being used in control sequences.

If a status from any device is not received upon request during initialization, the system shall automatically request the status again; failure to receive a valid status after a configurable number of retries shall be considered a device failure.
The control unit has successfully identified itself by reading the cabinet ID.
All required cards in the control unit are present and working properly.
The control system integrity check has passed without failure.
All specified tables have been initialized.
The startup process completed within 30 seconds.
The system is monitoring all devices associated with the control unit.
The system is sending the current device status to the FCU or TSU every 2 seconds (or at the rate specified in System Control Parameters).
